name: Core Strategy and Policies for Management of Development (as amended)

housing-numbers.notes: Focused Review pertaining to compliance with the NPPF. Review updated policies CSSP5, CSTP8, CSTP23, STP25, CSTP26, CSTP27, CSTP28, CSTP31, CSTP32, PMD1, PMD2, PMD4, PMD6, PMD7, PMD10, PMD12, PMD15 and PMD16. Housing requirement policy (CSSP1) not materially altered by the Focused Review; policy dates to the Core Strategy (adopted 2011). Based on requirement of 18,500 2001-2021 (925 homes/annum) and 4,750 2021-2026 (950 homes/annum).
